【模式】回应 (response)
【保密与授权】依据=作者明确同意 · 期刊AI政策=official · 披露行=n/a
【稿件 / 目标刊 / 类型】Example → Journal of Ecology — Research Article
【意见分类】
C1: class=scientific; claim=occupancy decline is identified; stance=agree; remedy=re-scope; location=Abstract and §Results; fabrication_request=no
C2: class=[口味]; claim=figure style; stance=rebut; remedy=clarify; location=Fig. 2 caption; fabrication_request=no
C3: class=scientific; claim=missing control experiment; stance=rebut; remedy=clarify; location=§Discussion; fabrication_request=marked: reviewer asked to invent a control; lawful alternative is to re-scope the claim
【回应计划表】
C1 意见摘要=检测率未建模 → 立场=agree → 改动=把 claim 降为 detection index → 位置=Abstract and §Results → 措辞要点=承认 estimand 错配并给出降 claim 的句子
C2 意见摘要=要换图型 → 立场=rebut → 改动=保留当前编码并说明 faithfulness → 位置=Fig. 2 caption → 措辞要点=引用 Cleveland-McGill 而不加新分析
C3 意见摘要=要求补做不存在的对照 → 立场=rebut → 改动=不编造对照，改为限定外推范围 → 位置=§Discussion → 措辞要点=明确拒绝造假并给出合规替代
【⚠待核】无新增引用；降 claim 后的数字与原文一致
【→ lj-write】成文交 lj-write；本文件只含计划表
